files.purpose: Configure Jac 0.36.1 [project] name, version, description, entry-point main.jac and kind service; no npm dependencies, no plugins and no version pin. The model is declared in services/appService.jac, not here.

Single service module. Import Model from jaclang.byllm.lib and declare glob llm: Model (tests replace svc.llm with MockLLM). Nodes (field order and defaults exact): Goal(title:str, description:str="", timeline:str="3 months", progress:int=0, status:str="active", created_at:str=""); Mission(title:str, difficulty:str="Medium", xp:int=100, done:bool=False, tag:str="General", goal_id:str=""); MemoryEntry(summary:str, tags:str="", focus_score:int=80, duration:str="1h", created_at:str=""); AgentLog(agent_name:str, action:str, detail:str="", timestamp:str="", status:str="completed"). obj InsightReport(insights:list[str], coach_message:str, predicted_completion:str, risk_level:str) with the verbatim sem strings. async ai_generate_insights is a by llm(temperature=0.5, max_tokens=800) function with no body. All entities hang directly off root and are found with [root -->][?:Type]; ids are jid(node) strings; lists come back in insertion order. log_agent(agent_name, action, detail) connects AgentLog(agent_name, action, detail, timestamp="now", status="completed") to root. get_goals/get_missions/get_memories return all nodes of that type on root. update_goal_progress finds the Goal whose jid equals goal_id, sets progress, logs ("Analytics", "Progress updated to " + str(progress) + "%", goal title), then if progress >= 100 logs ("Coach", "Goal completed! Celebrating achievement", title) elif progress >= 75 logs ("Coach", "75%+ reached — final push mode activated", title); returns the Goal, or None if no match. delete_goal logs ("Planner", "Goal removed from roadmap", title), deletes the node and returns True; False if no match. toggle_mission flips done on the matching Mission. When it becomes done it logs, in order, ("Execution", "Mission completed! +" + str(xp) + " XP earned", title), ("Memory", "Session logged — completed: " + tag + " task", title), ("Analytics", "Consistency streak updated", "+" + str(xp) + " XP"), then connects MemoryEntry(summary="Completed: " + title, tags=tag, focus_score=85, duration="1h", created_at="now") to root. When it becomes not done it only logs ("Execution", "Mission marked incomplete", title) and removes nothing. Returns the Mission, or None if no match. delete_mission logs ("Planner", "Mission removed from plan", title), deletes the node, returns True; False if no match. get_agent_logs returns all AgentLog nodes, or only the last 20 when there are more than 20. get_stats returns {"total_goals": #goals, "total_missions": #missions, "done_missions": #missions with done True, "total_xp": sum of xp of done missions, "avg_progress": sum of goal progress // #goals, or 0 with no goals}. get_agent_status returns a dict with keys planner, execution, memory, analytics, coach, research, each a dict {status, task, tasks_done}: planner = active/"Managing " + str(#goals) + " active goals" when #goals > 0 else idle/"Waiting for first goal", tasks_done #goals; execution = active/str(#missions - #done) + " missions in queue" when #missions > #done else idle/"All missions complete", tasks_done #done; memory = active/"Indexed " + str(#memories) + " sessions" when #memories > 0 else idle/"No sessions logged yet", tasks_done #memories; analytics = active if #done > 0 else idle, task "Tracking " + str(#done) + " completed missions", tasks_done #AgentLog nodes; coach = {"status": "active", "task": "Monitoring consistency and motivation", "tasks_done": #done}; research = {"status": "idle", "task": "Ready to scan opportunities", "tasks_done": 0}. agent_get_insights(goal_id) counts all missions and done missions on root, defaults goal_title="your goal", timeline="3 months", progress=0 and overrides them from the Goal whose jid matches, logs ("Analytics", "Generating insights for", goal_title), then tries await ai_generate_insights(goal_title, timeline, progress, #done, #missions, 7); on success logs ("Coach", "AI insights delivered", goal_title) and returns the model's InsightReport unchanged. On any exception: pct = #done * 100 // #missions (0 when no missions); risk_level "High" if pct < 30, elif pct < 60 "Medium", else "Low"; insights is exactly these four strings: "You have completed " + str(#done) + " of " + str(#missions) + " missions (" + str(pct) + "% completion rate).", "Current goal progress is at " + str(progress) + "% — keep pushing forward.", "Consistency is key — try to complete at least 1 mission per day.", "Focus on high-XP missions first to maximize your learning velocity."; coach_message "You're making progress on " + goal_title + ". Stay consistent and trust the process!"; predicted_completion "On track for " + timeline; it logs ("Coach", "Rule-based insights generated", goal_title) and returns that InsightReport. Goals, missions and memories are created by connecting nodes to root directly (no add_* operations in this slice).

signatures.Goal: node Goal { has title: str; has description: str = ""; has timeline: str = "3 months"; has progress: int = 0; has status: str = "active"; has created_at: str = ""; }
signatures.Mission: node Mission { has title: str; has difficulty: str = "Medium"; has xp: int = 100; has done: bool = False; has tag: str = "General"; has goal_id: str = ""; }
signatures.MemoryEntry: node MemoryEntry { has summary: str; has tags: str = ""; has focus_score: int = 80; has duration: str = "1h"; has created_at: str = ""; }
signatures.AgentLog: node AgentLog { has agent_name: str; has action: str; has detail: str = ""; has timestamp: str = ""; has status: str = "completed"; }
signatures.InsightReport: obj InsightReport { has insights: list[str]; has coach_message: str; has predicted_completion: str; has risk_level: str; }
signatures.ai_generate_insights: async def ai_generate_insights(goal_title: str, timeline: str, progress: int, done_missions: int, total_missions: int, days_active: int) -> InsightReport by llm(temperature=0.5, max_tokens=800);
signatures.sem strings (verbatim): sem InsightReport.insights = "List of 4 specific AI insights about the user's progress. Each insight should be 1 sentence, specific and actionable. Include strengths, weaknesses, patterns, and predictions."; sem InsightReport.coach_message = "A motivating, personalized coach message in 1-2 sentences based on the user's current progress."; sem InsightReport.predicted_completion = "Predicted completion date or timeframe based on current progress rate. Be specific."; sem InsightReport.risk_level = "Risk assessment: Low, Medium, or High based on current trajectory."; sem ai_generate_insights = "You are the Analytics and Coach Agent in FutureOS. Analyze the user's progress data and generate personalized insights, predictions, and coaching advice."; sem ai_generate_insights.goal_title = "The user's goal title"; sem ai_generate_insights.timeline = "The target timeline for the goal"; sem ai_generate_insights.progress = "Current progress percentage (0-100)"; sem ai_generate_insights.done_missions = "Number of missions completed"; sem ai_generate_insights.total_missions = "Total number of missions"; sem ai_generate_insights.days_active = "Number of days the user has been working on this goal";
signatures.log_agent: def log_agent(agent_name: str, action: str, detail: str) -> None
signatures.update_goal_progress: def:pub update_goal_progress(goal_id: str, progress: int) -> Goal | None

files.purpose: Thin entry module with the docstring "FutureOS — Adaptive AI Life Operating System" and a single import from services.appService of Goal, Mission, MemoryEntry, AgentLog, InsightReport, get_goals, update_goal_progress, delete_goal, get_missions, toggle_mission, delete_mission, get_memories, get_agent_logs, get_agent_status, get_stats and agent_get_insights. No declarations of its own; tests import these names from main.

signatures.imports: import from services.appService { Goal, Mission, MemoryEntry, AgentLog, InsightReport, get_goals, update_goal_progress, delete_goal, get_missions, toggle_mission, delete_mission, get_memories, get_agent_logs, get_agent_status, get_stats, agent_get_insights }

verify.flow: seed Goal/Mission nodes on root -> toggle/update/delete -> stats/status/logs -> insights with MockLLM answer and with a failing MockLLM
verify.steps: Run jac check main.jac and jac test with JAC_TEST_NATIVE=1 JAC_TEST_JOBS=0; replace services.appService.llm with MockLLM before calling agent_get_insights (asyncio.run); a MockLLM with no outputs raises, which exercises the rule-based fallback.

assumption: Backend slice of FutureOS (kshitijkumrawat20/JacHacks2026): services/appService.jac trimmed to the goal/mission/memory/log/stats/insight operations, with main.jac reduced to its import statement. Graph root persists across tests, so tests use unique titles and deltas.
